proposals.before: In the third year of Guangxu he was transferred to the An-Xiang-Jing-Qin circuit.
proposals.after: In the third year of Guangxu he was transferred to the An-Xiang-Jing-Yun circuit.
proposals.reason: The place name 荊鄖 is Jing-Yun; 鄖 is Yun, not Qin.

proposals.before: In the third year of Guangxu he was transferred to the An-Xiang-Jing-Qin circuit intendancy.
proposals.after: In the third year of Guangxu he was transferred to the An-Xiang-Jing-Yun circuit intendancy.
proposals.reason: The place name 荊鄖 is Jing-Yun; 鄖 is Yun, not Qin.

proposals.before: Earlier, when the French attacked Thuan An, Vietnam had not yet been beaten yet still rushed to sue for peace.
proposals.after: Earlier, when the French attacked Thuan An, Vietnam had not yet been beaten but still rushed to sue for peace.
proposals.reason: The repeated “yet” is a grammatical error; the second contrast requires “but still.”

proposals.before: He passed the provincial examination in the twenty-ninth year of Daoguang and was the son of Instructor Tang.
proposals.after: He passed the provincial examination in the twenty-ninth year of Daoguang and was the son of Tang Xunfang.
proposals.reason: 訓方 is the father's given name, Xunfang, not the occupational phrase “Instructor Tang.”

proposals.before: In the twenty-ninth year of Daoguang he became a provincial graduate; he was the son of Instructor Tang.
proposals.after: In the twenty-ninth year of Daoguang he became a provincial graduate; he was the son of Tang Xunfang.
proposals.reason: 訓方 is the father's given name, Xunfang, not the occupational phrase “Instructor Tang.”

proposals.before: When the French seized Vietnam from China, he was ordered to Kaifeng on defense duty and was appointed governor on the spot before the army.
proposals.after: When the French seized Vietnam from China, he was ordered to Kaihua on defense duty and was appointed governor on the spot before the army.
proposals.reason: 開化 is Kaihua, not Kaifeng (開封).

proposals.before: The French seized our Vietnam; he was ordered to go to Kaifeng to defend, and was at once appointed governor before the army.
proposals.after: The French seized our Vietnam; he was ordered to go to Kaihua to defend, and was at once appointed governor before the army.
proposals.reason: 開化 is Kaihua, not Kaifeng (開封).

decisions.reason: s0005 安襄荊鄖道 ends in 荊鄖; 鄖 is Yun, not Qin. The idiomatic Qin misreads the circuit name; Yun restores the Chinese place.
s0005 荊鄖 is Jing-Yun; the literal’s Qin is the same place-name error as in the idiomatic and must be corrected.
s0018 越未敗，遽乞和 contrasts not yet defeated with hasty peace-seeking; the doubled “yet…yet still” is ungrammatical, and “but still” correctly marks that contrast without changing sense.
s0058 訓方子 names the father as 訓方 (Xunfang); s0059 訓方督師金口 confirms it is a personal name, not an occupational “Instructor Tang.”
s0058 訓方 is the father’s given name Xunfang; the literal “Instructor Tang” invents a title and must be replaced with Tang Xunfang.
s0109 赴開化防守 names 開化 (Kaihua), not 開封 (Kaifeng); the idiomatic place must be corrected.
s0109 開化 is Kaihua; the literal Kaifeng is a different city (開封) and the proposed Kaihua matches the Chinese.
